setEffects.name: Resolution of Sojourner
setEffects.description: Increases Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 30%.

parts.name: Heart of Comradeship
parts.description: A small cerulean flower with somebody's ribbon pinned to the stem.

parts.name: Crown of Parting
parts.description: A reed coronet that emanates the spring breeze.

parts.name: Feather of Homecoming
parts.description: A blue arrow fletching imbued with the sentiment of travelers that had once faded into the horizon.

parts.name: Goblet of the Sojourner
parts.description: A plain porcelain goblet that was once brimming with joyous brews.

parts.name: Sundial of the Sojourner
parts.description: A sundial that has survived the ages, always silently recording the cycles of the sun and moon as they pass through the sky.

setEffects.name: Brave Heart
setEffects.description: Increases DMG by 30% against opponents with more than 50% HP.

parts.name: Medal of the Brave
parts.description: A simple flower brooch that is a keepsake from someone's first adventure.

parts.name: Crown of the Brave
parts.description: A rough-and-ready laurel wreath that seems as precious as a king's golden crown.

parts.name: Prospect of the Brave
parts.description: A shimmering feather from a songbird that brings a nudge of courage to its wearer.

parts.name: Outset of the Brave
parts.description: A crude wooden vessel filled only with memories.

parts.name: Fortitude of the Brave
parts.description: A dated miniature hourglass that serves no practical purpose. It seems as elusive as time itself.

setEffects.name: Defender's Will
setEffects.description: DEF +30%

setEffects.name: Defender's Will
setEffects.description: For each different element present in your own party, the wearer's Elemental RES to that corresponding element is increased by 30%.

parts.name: Guardian's Flower
parts.description: An iris that was cherished by the guardian. Unfortunately, the chance never came for it to be given to whom the guardian loved.

parts.name: Guardian's Band
parts.description: A fabric band dyed indigo by the darkness of night. Can also double as a bandage in the event of an emergency.

parts.name: Guardian's Sigil
parts.description: A feather-shaped brooch that symbolizes someone's yearning to defend others like a shield.

parts.name: Guardian's Vessel
parts.description: A metal vessel that can be filled with a drink to dispel the loneliness of the long watch.

parts.name: Guardian's Clock
parts.description: A small timekeeping gadget. On moonless nights, it was the only way its former owner could know the time.

setEffects.name: Tiny Miracle
setEffects.description: All Elemental RES increased by 20%.

setEffects.name: Tiny Miracle
setEffects.description: Incoming elemental DMG increases corresponding Elemental RES by 30% for 10s. Can only occur once every 10s.

parts.name: Tiny Miracle's Flower
parts.description: A flower that grew from a rock, breaking through the stone as it strove to reach the light.

parts.name: Tiny Miracle's Earrings
parts.description: A cheap accessory that is actually made from ancient meteoric ore.

parts.name: Tiny Miracle's Feather
parts.description: A feather from a bird of prey that flies almost too fast for the human eye to detect.

parts.name: Tiny Miracle's Goblet
parts.description: A cup commonly used for fortune-telling. It can also hold water, of course.

parts.name: Tiny Miracle's Hourglass
parts.description: Just an ordinary, everyday hourglass. Turn it upside down and sure enough, the dry sand starts trickling down like water.

setEffects.name: Berserker
setEffects.description: CRIT Rate +12%

setEffects.name: Berserker
setEffects.description: When HP is below 70%, CRIT Rate increases by an additional 24%.

parts.name: Berserker's Rose
parts.description: An exquisite flower that has been dyed red. It represents the qualities of the Berserker.

parts.name: Berserker's Battle Mask
parts.description: A hideous iron mask that has been left half-shattered from vicious battles.

parts.name: Berserker's Indigo Feather
parts.description: An indigo feather from a legendary raven, part of which has been dyed crimson red.

parts.name: Berserker's Bone Goblet
parts.description: A goblet made from the bone of an unknown beast. It was taken as a trophy after some deadly encounter.

parts.name: Berserker's Timepiece
parts.description: An instrument with an eternal flow that continues mercilessly within, reminding the Berserker of the limited time he has left — both on the battlefield as well as in the world.

setEffects.name: Martial Artist
setEffects.description: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%

setEffects.name: Martial Artist
setEffects.description: After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 25% for 8s.

parts.name: Martial Artist's Red Flower
parts.description: This particular kind of red flower was the only thing that could alleviate the Martial Artist's pain.

parts.name: Martial Artist's Bandana
parts.description: The first lesson as an apprentice: Vigor, Strength, Will. These words are written on the bandana so you'll never forget them.

parts.name: Martial Artist's Feather Accessory
parts.description: A common bird feather. Experts use it to practice strength control, while rookies use it to make fans.

parts.name: Martial Artist's Wine Cup
parts.description: A rather exquisite wine cup used in pre-combat rituals.

parts.name: Martial Artist's Water Hourglass
parts.description: A tool to keep track of time in endurance training. It is more accurate and reliable than a regular hourglass.

setEffects.name: Instructor
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Instructor
setEffects.description: Upon triggering an Elemental Reaction, increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 120 for 8s.

parts.name: Instructor's Brooch
parts.description: Whenever the instructor wore this brooch, it meant there would be no training sessions that day.

parts.name: Instructor's Cap
parts.description: A standard-issue honorary instructor's cap, only granted to those who turn down a promotion.

parts.name: Instructor's Feather Accessory
parts.description: Any instructor who has mastered the art of de-escalation knows to keep this accessory firmly in their grasp at all times.

parts.name: Instructor's Tea Cup
parts.description: It may seem like an ordinary tea cup to most. But to students, it is the symbol of the instructor's authority.

parts.name: Instructor's Pocket Watch
parts.description: A stopwatch used not for general timekeeping but to measure the duration of a training session.

setEffects.name: Gambler
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 20%.

setEffects.name: Gambler
setEffects.description: Defeating an opponent has a 100% chance to remove Elemental Skill CD. Can only occur once every 15s.

parts.name: Gambler's Brooch
parts.description: A big, luxurious flower that can hide loaded dice.

parts.name: Gambler's Earrings
parts.description: A pair of blue earrings that, when worn, calm the mind and encourage a rational assessment of risks.

parts.name: Gambler's Feather Accessory
parts.description: The tail feather of a large bird. Perfect for discretely concealing a trump card.

parts.name: Gambler's Dice Cup
parts.description: This vessel was specially made for a single purpose. It has absolutely no secret compartments built into it.

parts.name: Gambler's Pocket Watch
parts.description: A shattered pocket watch that once took a lethal hit for its owner.

setEffects.name: The Exile
setEffects.description: Energy Recharge +20%

setEffects.name: The Exile
setEffects.description: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates 2 Energy for all party members (excluding the wearer) every 2s for 6s. This effect cannot stack.

parts.name: Exile's Flower
parts.description: A withered flower worn on the shirt. Its former owner insisted on wearing it even in exile, so it must mean something.

parts.name: Exile's Circlet
parts.description: A prestigious circlet. However, the royal insignia has been scratched out, and it is no longer the symbol of distinguished status that it once was.

parts.name: Exile's Feather
parts.description: Not an actual accessory per se. Just a random bird feather that was found somewhere in the wilderness by the exile.

parts.name: Exile's Goblet
parts.description: A dull goblet made of a heavy metal. It was once inlaid with gemstones, but they have since been stripped off.

parts.name: Exile's Pocket Watch
parts.description: Even after the crystal watch face was shattered and the hands lost, its former owner kept it until the end.

setEffects.name: Adventurer
setEffects.description: Max HP increased by 1,000.

setEffects.name: Adventurer
setEffects.description: Opening a chest regenerates 30% Max HP over 5s.

parts.name: Adventurer's Flower
parts.description: A resilient flower that survived the harsh environment of an ancient city. It is now proudly worn like a medal.

parts.name: Adventurer's Bandana
parts.description: A cloth garment worn at the forehead. Though soaked in sweat and covered in dust, it still beams with an adventurer's pride.

parts.name: Adventurer's Tail Feather
parts.description: The feather of an exotic bird rarely seen on this continent.

parts.name: Adventurer's Golden Goblet
parts.description: The spoils of one of an adventurer's many expeditions. Though a little damaged, it is still an excellent find.

parts.name: Adventurer's Pocket Watch
parts.description: It's easy to lose track of time when you're adventuring where the sun doesn't shine, whether that's the depths of the abyss or the ruins of a lost city.

setEffects.name: Lucky Dog
setEffects.description: DEF increased by 100.

setEffects.name: Lucky Dog
setEffects.description: Picking up Mora restores 300 HP.

parts.name: Lucky Dog's Clover
parts.description: A four-leaf clover that grows in the wild. It was picked because it is said to bring good luck.

parts.name: Lucky Dog's Silver Circlet
parts.description: Its former owner once fell into a cave and found the treasure trove of an exiled royal. This is a souvenir from that incident.

parts.name: Lucky Dog's Eagle Feather
parts.description: A monster once cornered an adventurer, but was then picked off by a hunting eagle... That eagle dropped this feather, which now carries some of the adventurer's good luck.

parts.name: Lucky Dog's Goblet
parts.description: An exquisite metallic vessel that was once used to knock out a thief.

parts.name: Lucky Dog's Hourglass
parts.description: A broken hourglass from which all the sand has escaped. But it's fine, because the passage of time means nothing to someone without a single worry in the whole world.

setEffects.name: Scholar
setEffects.description: Energy Recharge +20%

setEffects.name: Scholar
setEffects.description: Gaining Elemental Particles or Orbs gives 3 Energy to all party members who have a bow or a catalyst equipped. Can only occur once every 3s.

parts.name: Scholar's Bookmark
parts.description: A dried flower used as a bookmark. It has absorbed the scent from the pages.

parts.name: Scholar's Lens
parts.description: This corrective lens helped restore the vision of one whose eyes were damaged from intensive studying.

parts.name: Scholar's Quill Pen
parts.description: A bird's feather that serves as a quill pen. The tip has long been stained black.

parts.name: Scholar's Ink Cup
parts.description: Originally designed to hold drinking water, this cup was stained black after a scholar used it to wash their paint brushes.

parts.name: Scholar's Clock
parts.description: A small desktop clock, whose former owner was a scholar sat in a windowless room buried in books. This was probably the only reference they had to the time of day.

setEffects.name: Traveling Doctor
setEffects.description: Increases incoming healing by 20%.

setEffects.name: Traveling Doctor
setEffects.description: Using Elemental Burst restores 20% HP.

parts.name: Traveling Doctor's Silver Lotus
parts.description: A precious medicinal ingredient that has lost all medicinal value after years in storage.

parts.name: Traveling Doctor's Handkerchief
parts.description: Used to tie back the doctor's hair when treating patients. Can also be used as a sling for sprains and broken arms in emergencies.

parts.name: Traveling Doctor's Owl Feather
parts.description: The durable feather of an owl. Emblematic of nocturnal supremacy, it gave some encouragement to the Traveling Doctor when venturing out to visit patients late at night.

parts.name: Traveling Doctor's Medicine Pot
parts.description: This pot used to carry concentrated and extremely potent concoctions. It is now empty, but still gives off a strong smell of medicine.

parts.name: Traveling Doctor's Pocket Watch
parts.description: A precise instrument used for keeping time. For a doctor, every second counts.

setEffects.name: Blizzard Strayer
setEffects.description: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Blizzard Strayer
setEffects.description: When a character attacks an opponent affected by Cryo, their CRIT Rate is increased by 20%. If the opponent is Frozen, CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 20%.

setEffects.name: Thundersoother
setEffects.description: Electro RES increased by 40%.

setEffects.name: Thundersoother
setEffects.description: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Electro by 35%.

parts.name: Thundersoother's Heart
parts.description: A flower that blooms even amidst ferocious thunder and lightning. To this day, it still grants courage to travelers in thunderstorms.

parts.name: Thundersoother's Diadem
parts.description: The crown given to the Thundersoother for defeating the Beast of Thunder that had been wreaking havoc upon the land.

parts.name: Thundersoother's Plume
parts.description: The feather of a predatory bird that soars through lightning storms. It was said to have been adopted as an insignia by the legendary hero who pacified thunder and lightning.

parts.name: Thundersoother's Goblet
parts.description: The wine goblet from which the Thundersoother, who defeated the Beast of Thunder, once drank violet lightning.

parts.name: Hour of Soothing Thunder
parts.description: A timepiece kept by the hero who conquered thunder and lightning. The tiny shards of Electro crystal within flow back and forth with the passing of time.

setEffects.name: Lavawalker
setEffects.description: Pyro RES increased by 40%.

setEffects.name: Lavawalker
setEffects.description: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro by 35%.

parts.name: Lavawalker's Resolution
parts.description: A flower that blooms amidst burning flames. It is said that long ago, a sage once wore it as he walked into a sea of fire.

parts.name: Lavawalker's Wisdom
parts.description: The circlet of a sage who traversed a sea of fire. It once shone brightly from their ancient silhouette as they stood strong amidst the flames.

parts.name: Lavawalker's Salvation
parts.description: The feather of a proud phoenix. You can almost hear the sound of its wings flapping in the scorching flames.

parts.name: Lavawalker's Epiphany
parts.description: A legendary goblet that can withstand extremely high temperatures. It still retains a degree of warmth even though it is now empty.

parts.name: Lavawalker's Torment
parts.description: Burning sand flows within this hourglass. Despite the intense heat, the sand leave no mark upon the vessel that houses it.

setEffects.name: Maiden Beloved
setEffects.description: Character Healing Effectiveness +15%

setEffects.name: Maiden Beloved
setEffects.description: Using an Elemental Skill or Burst increases healing received by all party members by 20% for 10s.

setEffects.name: Gladiator's Finale
setEffects.description: If the wielder of this artifact set uses a Sword, Claymore or Polearm, increases their Normal Attack DMG by 35%.

setEffects.name: Viridescent Venerer
setEffects.description: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Viridescent Venerer
setEffects.description: Increases Swirl DMG by 60%. Decreases opponent's Elemental RES to the element infused in the Swirl by 40% for 10s.

setEffects.name: Wanderer's Troupe
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Wanderer's Troupe
setEffects.description: Increases Charged Attack DMG by 35% if the character uses a Catalyst or a Bow.

parts.name: Troupe's Dawnlight
parts.description: A small flower-shaped insignia. If you listen carefully, you can almost hear a flute playing and voices singing.

parts.name: Conductor's Top Hat
parts.description: A top hat that has managed to retain its radiance despite braving the elements for time untold. An ancient tune still resonates within.

parts.name: Bard's Arrow Feather
parts.description: An azure arrow fletching that has neither faded nor splintered with the passage of time. The sound of running water seems to linger around it.

parts.name: Wanderer's String-Kettle
parts.description: An ancient, strangely-shaped canteen. The interior is fitted with harp strings, which play a wondrous tune as the water flows out.

parts.name: Concert's Final Hour
parts.description: An hourglass used to keep time during a band performance. It once made a crisp sound, but their performance has since ended.

setEffects.name: Glacier and Snowfield
setEffects.description: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Glacier and Snowfield
setEffects.description: Increases Superconduct DMG by 100%. Increases Melt DMG by 15%. Using an Elemental Burst increases Cryo DMG Bonus by 30% for 10s.

parts.name: Heart of Frost
parts.description: A flower that has been frozen in time from the moment it was picked. The knight kept it as a memento forever after.

parts.name: Crown of Glacier
parts.description: The crown worn by the knight who walked with the North Wind. It was forged using winter ice and silver.

parts.name: Plume of Snow
parts.description: A bird feather that was picked up by the knight who walked with the North Wind in the snow. It still awaits the day when it will thaw.

parts.name: Goblet of Aquilo
parts.description: A goblet of eonothem left behind by the knight who walked with the North Wind. The chill of the bitter winter frost still lingers within.

parts.name: Glacial Sand
parts.description: A timepiece once used by the knight who walked with the North Wind. A never-ending snowstorm rages within.

setEffects.name: Thundering Fury
setEffects.description: Electro DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Thundering Fury
setEffects.description: Increases the DMG caused by Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, and Hyperbloom by 40%, the DMG Bonus conferred by Aggravate by 20%, and the DMG caused by Lunar-Charged by 20%. When Quicken or the aforementioned Elemental Reactions are triggered, Elemental Skill CD is decreased by 1s. Can only occur once every 0.8s.

setEffects.name: Crimson Witch of Flames
setEffects.description: Pyro DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Crimson Witch of Flames
setEffects.description: Increases Overloaded, Burning, and Burgeon DMG by 40%. Increases Vaporize and Melt DMG by 15%. Using Elemental Skill increases the 2-Piece Set Bonus by 50% of its starting value for 10s. Max 3 stacks.

setEffects.name: Noblesse Oblige
setEffects.description: Elemental Burst DMG +20%

setEffects.name: Noblesse Oblige
setEffects.description: Using an Elemental Burst increases all party members' ATK by 20% for 12s. This effect cannot stack.

setEffects.name: Bloodstained Chivalry
setEffects.description: Physical DMG +25%

setEffects.name: Bloodstained Chivalry
setEffects.description: After defeating an opponent, increases Charged Attack DMG by 50%, and reduces its Stamina cost to 0 for 10s.

setEffects.name: Prayers for Illumination
setEffects.description: Affected by Pyro for 40% less time.

parts.name: Tiara of Flame
parts.description: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. After being subjected to the dancing sacrificial flames year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.name: Prayers for Destiny
setEffects.description: Affected by Hydro for 40% less time.

parts.name: Tiara of Torrents
parts.description: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it was submerged in water year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.name: Prayers for Wisdom
setEffects.description: Affected by Electro for 40% less time.

parts.name: Tiara of Thunder
parts.description: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it harkened to the call of thunder year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.name: Prayers to the Firmament
setEffects.description: Affected by Anemo for 40% less time.

parts.name: Tiara of Gales
parts.description: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Wind once freely flowed through the various openings in the headdress.

setEffects.name: Prayers to Springtime
setEffects.description: Affected by Cryo for 40% less time.

parts.name: Tiara of Frost
parts.description: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it once weathered years of the icy cold, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.name: Archaic Petra
setEffects.description: Gain a 15% Geo DMG Bonus.

setEffects.name: Archaic Petra
setEffects.description: Upon obtaining an Elemental Shard created through Crystallize or triggering a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, all party members gain a 35% DMG Bonus for that particular element for 10s. Only one form of Elemental DMG Bonus can be gained in this manner at any one time.

parts.name: Feather of Jagged Peaks
parts.description: A hard feather from a large seacliff hawk. The basalt tip of the feather sometimes glistens with a cool dew.

parts.name: Goblet of Chiseled Crag
parts.description: A resplendent yet dignified wine goblet, once filled to the brim in an era long gone.

setEffects.name: Retracing Bolide
setEffects.description: Increases Shield Strength by 35%.

setEffects.name: Retracing Bolide
setEffects.description: While protected by a shield, gain an additional 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG.

setEffects.name: Heart of Depth
setEffects.description: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Heart of Depth
setEffects.description: After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 30% for 15s.

setEffects.name: Tenacity of the Millelith
setEffects.description: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, the ATK of all nearby party members is increased by 20% and their Shield Strength is increased by 30% for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

setEffects.name: Pale Flame
setEffects.description: Physical DMG is increased by 25%.

setEffects.name: Pale Flame
setEffects.description: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK is increased by 9% for 7s. This effect stacks up to 2 times and can be triggered once every 0.3s. Once 2 stacks are reached, the 2-set effect is increased by 100%.

setEffects.name: Shimenawa's Reminiscence
setEffects.description: When casting an Elemental Skill, if the character has 15 or more Energy, they lose 15 Energy and Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 50% for 10s. This effect will not trigger again during that duration.

setEffects.name: Emblem of Severed Fate
setEffects.description: Energy Recharge +20%

setEffects.name: Emblem of Severed Fate
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Burst DMG by 25% of Energy Recharge. A maximum of 75% bonus DMG can be obtained in this way.

setEffects.name: Husk of Opulent Dreams
setEffects.description: DEF +30%

setEffects.name: Husk of Opulent Dreams
setEffects.description: A character equipped with this Artifact set will obtain the Curiosity effect in the following conditions: When on the field, the character gains 1 stack after hitting an opponent with a Geo attack, triggering a maximum of once every 0.3s. When off the field, the character gains 1 stack every 3s. Curiosity can stack up to 4 times, each providing 6% DEF and a 6% Geo DMG Bonus. When 6 seconds pass without gaining a Curiosity stack, 1 stack is lost.

setEffects.name: Ocean-Hued Clam
setEffects.description: Healing Bonus +15%.

setEffects.name: Ocean-Hued Clam
setEffects.description: When the character equipping this artifact set heals a character in the party, a Sea-Dyed Foam will appear for 3 seconds, accumulating the amount of HP recovered from healing (including overflow healing). At the end of the duration, the Sea-Dyed Foam will explode, dealing DMG to nearby opponents based on 90% of the accumulated healing. (This DMG is calculated similarly to Reactions such as Electro-Charged, and Superconduct, but is not affected by Elemental Mastery, Character Levels, or Reaction DMG Bonuses). Only one Sea-Dyed Foam can be produced every 3.5 seconds. Each Sea-Dyed Foam can accumulate up to 30,000 HP (including overflow healing). There can be no more than one Sea-Dyed Foam active at any given time. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

parts.name: Sea-Dyed Blossom
parts.description: A soft flower that has taken on the many shades of the capricious ocean. It shines with wondrous colors under the moon's silver light.

parts.name: Crown of Watatsumi
parts.description: An ancient, intricate crown that was once used by a forgotten clergy member. Today, this relic has been enshrined with great ceremony by the people of Watatsumi.

parts.name: Deep Palace's Plume
parts.description: A down feather with the same hue as coral, said to come from a shrine maiden's ceremonial garment.

parts.name: Pearl Cage
parts.description: The shining pearls that the shrine maidens of Watatsumi Island offer up shine eternally and never dim.

parts.name: Cowry of Parting
parts.description: A clean, flawless seashell that comes from the bottomless ocean.

setEffects.name: Vermillion Hereafter
setEffects.description: After using an Elemental Burst, this character will gain the Nascent Light effect, increasing their ATK by 8% for 16s. When the character's HP decreases, their ATK will further increase by 10%. This further increase can occur this way a maximum of 4 times. This effect can be triggered once every 0.8s. Nascent Light will be dispelled when the character leaves the field. If an Elemental Burst is used again during the duration of Nascent Light, the original Nascent Light will be dispelled.

parts.name: Flowering Life
parts.description: An ancient memento. It still looks as alive as the being that preserved it several centuries ago.

parts.name: Thundering Poise
parts.description: This mask is said to have been made by the mountain people for a Yaksha. It is of simple make, but its surface still shines brightly nonetheless.

parts.name: Feather of Nascent Light
parts.description: A dimly lustrous pinion steeped in strong memories.

parts.name: Moment of the Pact
parts.description: An old cup made of sand crystal. Its luster is somehow undimmed by age.

parts.name: Solar Relic
parts.description: An ancient timepiece with a mighty solid look. Its luster is produced by sand crystal.

setEffects.name: Echoes of an Offering
setEffects.description: When Normal Attacks hit opponents, there is a 36% chance that it will trigger Valley Rite, which will increase Normal Attack DMG by 70% of ATK. This effect will be dispelled 0.05s after a Normal Attack deals DMG. If a Normal Attack fails to trigger Valley Rite, the odds of it triggering the next time will increase by 20%. This trigger can occur once every 0.2s.

parts.name: Soulscent Bloom
parts.description: A jade carved into the shape of a flower. A phantom scent, here one instant and gone the next, swirls around it.

parts.name: Flowing Rings
parts.description: A pair of earrings made from a single piece of jade. It has a most gentle texture.

parts.name: Jade Leaf
parts.description: A jade ornament shaped like a leaf. It seems to have once had deep meaning between specific friends.

parts.name: Chalice of the Font
parts.description: This teacup forever overflows with fresh water. Perhaps it was a gift from an adeptus, one of their relics, or just something they left behind.

parts.name: Symbol of Felicitation
parts.description: A circular jade ornament. Legend has it that it was once used somewhere as a symbol for rituals to begin.

setEffects.name: Deepwood Memories
setEffects.description: Dendro DMG Bonus +15%.

setEffects.name: Deepwood Memories
setEffects.description: After Elemental Skills or Bursts hit opponents, the targets' Dendro RES will be decreased by 30% for 8s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.

parts.name: Labyrinth Wayfarer
parts.description: This lovely gold-plated flower was plucked from the crown of the ruler of the forest.

parts.name: Laurel Coronet
parts.description: This crown was bestowed by the deity with dominion over plants and trees. It was an heirloom of the royal house of the labyrinth. It was, at last, made the inheritance of the king's attendant.

parts.name: Scholar of Vines
parts.description: An emerald leaf as fluffy as a feather. Plucked from the raiment of a forest scholar.

parts.name: Lamp of the Lost
parts.description: This was originally an oil lamp in the style of the desert realm, but has since sprouted fluorescent green leaves.

parts.name: A Time of Insight
parts.description: Such timepieces are used by those who dedicate themselves to the way of the wise. These timepieces do not contain lifeless sand, but instead play host to tiny mustard seeds.

setEffects.name: Gilded Dreams
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Gilded Dreams
setEffects.description: Within 8s of triggering an Elemental Reaction, the character equipping this will obtain buffs based on the Elemental Type of the other party members. ATK is increased by 14% for each party member whose Elemental Type is the same as the equipping character, and Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for every party member with a different Elemental Type. Each of the aforementioned buffs will count up to 3 characters. This effect can be triggered once every 8s. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

parts.name: Dreaming Steelbloom
parts.description: A flower bud made of hammered dark gold. Its crimson core is wrapped by petals that shall never open.

parts.name: Shadow of the Sand King
parts.description: This gold-inlaid headband was once used by desert priests in the days of old. They were made in imitation of one worn by a legendary ruler of the desert peoples.

parts.name: Feather of Judgment
parts.description: This special feather was once used to weigh the hearts of the guilty, but it has since lost its original function.

parts.name: Honeyed Final Feast
parts.description: A wine cup that was once used at a grand and ancient feast. It has now lost much of that luster.

parts.name: The Sunken Years
parts.description: This dark-golden sundial seems to tell the ancient tale of the desert.

setEffects.name: Desert Pavilion Chronicle
setEffects.description: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Desert Pavilion Chronicle
setEffects.description: When Charged Attacks hit opponents, the equipping character's Normal Attack SPD will increase by 10% while Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG will increase by 40% for 15s.

parts.name: The First Days of the City of Kings
parts.description: An artificial flower that shimmers with a strange light. If you incline your ear to it, you can vaguely hear charming laughter issuing from within.

parts.name: Legacy of the Desert High-Born
parts.description: Earrings made from amber gold that shines with a strange light.

parts.name: End of the Golden Realm
parts.description: A crystal-clear artificial feather that is one of the legacies of an ancient human realm. The cries of soaring eagles are also sealed within.

parts.name: Defender of the Enchanting Dream
parts.description: An ancient golden cup that is both marvelously and luxuriously wrought. Murmurings can be heard within its empty innards.

parts.name: Timepiece of the Lost Path
parts.description: An ancient mechanical clock. The Jinni fragments continue to emit light at its center and vibrate ever so slightly, as if to say something...

setEffects.name: Flower of Paradise Lost
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Flower of Paradise Lost
setEffects.description: The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%, and their Lunar-Bloom reaction DMG is increased by 10%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon, they will gain another 25% bonus to the effects mentioned prior. Each stack of this lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks simultaneously. This effect can only be triggered once per second. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

parts.name: Ay-Khanoum's Myriad
parts.description: An amethyst bloom that has been beautifully sculpted in the image of an ancient, extinct flower.

parts.name: Amethyst Crown
parts.description: A crown inlaid with amethyst and emerald. It seems to have been the headgear worn by ancient priests of the Goddess of Flowers.

parts.name: Wilting Feast
parts.description: A feather left behind by a long-extinct bird species. It was inlaid with gold and gems by the ancient adherents of the Goddess of Flowers.

parts.name: Secret-Keeper's Magic Bottle
parts.description: A small bottle made of purple crystal. An emerald cap keeps it tightly sealed.

parts.name: A Moment Congealed
parts.description: These sands no longer move no matter how you tilt the hourglass, now and forever defying the drift of time itself.

setEffects.name: Nymph's Dream
setEffects.description: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Nymph's Dream
setEffects.description: After Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts hit opponents, 1 stack of Mirrored Nymph will be triggered, lasting 8s. When under the effect of 1, 2, or 3 or more Mirrored Nymph stacks, ATK will be increased by 7%/16%/25%, and Hydro DMG Bonus will be increased by 4%/9%/15%. Mirrored Nymph stacks created by Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts exist independently.

parts.name: Odyssean Flower
parts.description: The story must end, and even fresh flowers will wither. But the flower within one's dreams will always remain in full and fragrant bloom.

parts.name: Fell Dragon's Monocle
parts.description: An exquisitely-made monocle. Ancient anecdotes say that one might be able to see the future through it.

parts.name: Wicked Mage's Plumule
parts.description: This was once a decorative feather in someone's hat. Being dark green, it is quite eye-catching indeed.

parts.name: Heroes' Tea Party
parts.description: A lovely teacup. Perhaps it was once used by people enjoying a leisurely afternoon together.

parts.name: Nymph's Constancy
parts.description: A pocket watch that has long stopped working. It seems to have borne witness to many a passing year as its hands spun in vain.

setEffects.name: Vourukasha's Glow
setEffects.description: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by 10%. After the equipping character takes DMG, the aforementioned DMG Bonus is increased by 80% for 5s. This effect increase can have 5 stacks. The duration of each stack is counted independently. These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is not on the field.

parts.name: Stamen of Khvarena's Origin
parts.description: An insignia in the shape of a lovely little flower that was once worn by pilgrims in times long bygone.

parts.name: Heart of Khvarena's Brilliance
parts.description: Intricate and vibrant earrings upon which the luster of a hundred flowers seems to flow.

parts.name: Vibrant Pinion
parts.description: An exquisite feather-shaped decoration on which the vivid hues of verdant leaves and fragrant flowers shimmer.

parts.name: Feast of Boundless Joy
parts.description: An opulent wine goblet that was once filled with nectar and honeydew, but is empty today.

parts.name: Ancient Abscission
parts.description: An ancient timepiece upon which the light of Khvarena gleams. It is filled with a pure liquid that appears alive.

setEffects.name: Marechaussee Hunter
setEffects.description: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%

setEffects.name: Marechaussee Hunter
setEffects.description: When current HP increases or decreases, CRIT Rate will be increased by 12% for 5s. Max 3 stacks.

parts.name: Hunter's Brooch
parts.description: An ancient emblem that was once awarded to those who had made exceptional contributions in battle.

parts.name: Veteran's Visage
parts.description: An old mask that can, to some extent, stand in for a face marred by wounds. Its design can vary based on the wounded areas and the user's gender.

parts.name: Masterpiece's Overture
parts.description: A portable tool used to adjust the torque on some old-school clockwork machine. It has since lost its practical value.

parts.name: Forgotten Vessel
parts.description: A portable metal vessel containing strong wine. Can be stuffed into the pocket of an outer coat for ease of access and use.

parts.name: Moment of Judgment
parts.description: A standard pocket watch. Its accuracy is not particularly high.

setEffects.name: Golden Troupe
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 20%.

setEffects.name: Golden Troupe
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 25%. Additionally, when not on the field, Elemental Skill DMG will be further increased by 25%. This effect will be cleared 2s after taking the field.

parts.name: Golden Song's Variation
parts.description: A flower constructed out of clam, mother-of-pearl, and gold leaf. It blooms proudly.

parts.name: Golden Troupe's Reward
parts.description: An ancient crown that resembles a stage prop more than it does some suzerain's headgear.

parts.name: Golden Bird's Shedding
parts.description: A gold feather made using silver and gold filigree. A crystal-clear sapphire is mounted atop it.

parts.name: Golden Night's Bustle
parts.description: An ancient silver urn that was once filled with fine wine as red as rubies. Now, it contains nothing but bitter seawater.

parts.name: Golden Era's Prelude
parts.description: This lovely sundial is inlaid with silver and gold. It seems that time has stopped flowing atop its dial plate.

setEffects.name: Song of Days Past
setEffects.description: Healing Bonus +15%.

setEffects.name: Song of Days Past
setEffects.description: When the equipping character heals a party member, the Yearning effect will be created for 6s, which records the total amount of healing provided (including overflow healing). When the duration expires, the Yearning effect will be transformed into the "Waves of Days Past" effect: When your active party member hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, the DMG dealt will be increased by 8% of the total healing amount recorded by the Yearning effect. The "Waves of Days Past" effect is removed after it has taken effect 5 times or after 10s. A single instance of the Yearning effect can record up to 15,000 healing, and only a single instance can exist at once, but it can record the healing from multiple equipping characters. Equipping characters on standby can still trigger this effect.

parts.name: Forgotten Oath of Days Past
parts.description: An ever-blooming flower shaped from larimar and shimmering silver. They say that this is still viewed as a symbol of resistance.

parts.name: Poetry of Days Past
parts.description: A formal hat that was once in vogue amongst creators of opera in Fontaine. Word has it that its feathered adornment was based on the legendary helms of the Lochknights.

parts.name: Recollection of Days Past
parts.description: A butterfly-shaped feather accessory made from silver and azure crystals. It is said to, in the distant past, have symbolized an oath to never be parted.

parts.name: Promised Dream of Days Past
parts.description: An opulent vessel made based on the form of the legendary "Pure Grail." It is said to be able to fulfill the wishes of the purest of people.

parts.name: Echoing Sound From Days Past
parts.description: An oddly shaped hourglass made from lazurite and aqua jade. It was reportedly inspired by the bell tower in Petrichor.

name: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods

setEffects.name: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
setEffects.description: After using an Elemental Skill, gain a 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s. When under a shield granted by the Crystallize reaction, or when Moondrifts formed by Lunar-Crystallize reactions are nearby, the above effect is increased by 150%. When these conditions are no longer met, this additional increase disappears after 1s.

parts.name: Selfless Floral Accessory
parts.description: A brooch that the witch in the tale wore. As with the other ornaments she loved, this was characterized by butterfly-like shapes.

parts.name: Compassionate Ladies' Hat
parts.description: The lady's hat favored by the witch in the story. She loved this piece of headwear for how it weaves together solemnity and playfulness.

parts.name: Honest Quill
parts.description: The witch in the tale used this dip pen. Among its various advantages, its silky-smooth writing is the least worthy of mention.

parts.name: Magnanimous Ink Bottle
parts.description: An ink bottle utilized by the witch in the story. It possesses a strange enchantment no less powerful than the one cast upon the dip pen.

parts.name: Faithful Hourglass
parts.description: A sand timepiece that the witch relied on in the story. Legend has it that if you recite the wrong incantation over it, time will suddenly flow exceptionally quickly.

setEffects.name: Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy
setEffects.description: When the value of a Bond of Life increases or decreases, this character deals 18% increased DMG for 6s. Max 3 stacks.

parts.name: Harmonious Symphony Prelude
parts.description: An honorary medal in the shape of a blooming flower. Adorned with blue stone and gold, it was once bestowed upon immortals.

parts.name: Whimsical Dance of the Withered
parts.description: A mask once covered in gold leaf. Perhaps it is a relic from some ancient officer of the legions.

parts.name: Ancient Sea's Nocturnal Musing
parts.description: A feather accessory carved in the shape of the wings of the golden bees of legend. They seem to flutter with the slightest breeze.

parts.name: Ichor Shower Rhapsody
parts.description: A rhyton fired with copper as the base, that was once filled with fine wine from paradise.

parts.name: The Grand Jape of the Turning of Fate
parts.description: A timepiece made in imitation of the wheel of fate. It ceased turning long ago.

setEffects.name: Unfinished Reverie
setEffects.description: After leaving combat for 3s, DMG dealt increased by 50%. In combat, if no Burning opponents are nearby for more than 6s, this DMG Bonus will decrease by 10% per second until it reaches 0%. When a Burning opponent exists, it will increase by 10% instead until it reaches 50%. This effect still triggers if the equipping character is off-field.

parts.name: Dark Fruit of Bright Flowers
parts.description: A flower carved from grey stone covered with gold foil. Legends say that during a war, it was used to differentiate friend from foe.

parts.name: Crownless Crown
parts.description: A golden crown decorated with turquoise and emerald feathers, it has never been used in a coronation, living alone atop a velvet cushion.

parts.name: Faded Emerald Tail
parts.description: A tail feather ornament whose luster has long faded. The patterns on it are said to have been etched by the hand of a skilled artisan from long ago.

parts.name: The Wine-Flask Over Which the Plan Was Hatched
parts.description: A three-legged cup. Once, many heroes were gathered around the bonfire, raising their cups high in toast and drinking their fill while discussing their wishes and ambitions.

parts.name: Moment of Attainment
parts.description: A sundial used by an ancient kingdom to tell time. Tiny marks have been left at a certain scale that can only be seen through careful observation.

name: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

setEffects.name: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
setEffects.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the equipping character regenerates 6 Elemental Energy.

setEffects.name: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
setEffects.description: After the equipping character triggers a reaction related to their Elemental Type, all nearby party members gain a 12% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 15s. If the equipping character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state when triggering this effect, all nearby party members gain an additional 28% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 20s. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field, and the DMG bonus from Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

parts.name: Beast Tamer's Talisman
parts.description: A flower carved from flint and Drakite, signifying that its bearer is qualified to become a beast tamer.

parts.name: Demon-Warrior's Feather Mask
parts.description: A feather mask with falcon-esque plumage. Many legends surround this object.

parts.name: Mountain Ranger's Marker
parts.description: A signal used by mountain rangers to mark out paths. Their bird-feather shapes make them very eye-catching indeed.

parts.name: Wandering Scholar's Claw Cup
parts.description: A strange goblet strikingly similar in shape to a dragon's claw. Its maker must have made it with something special in mind.

parts.name: Mystic's Gold Dial
parts.description: A golden disc shaped like a sun. The draconic patterns on it seem to symbolize the cycle of life and death.

setEffects.name: Obsidian Codex
setEffects.description: While the equipping character is in Nightsoul's Blessing and is on the field, their DMG dealt is increased by 15%.

setEffects.name: Obsidian Codex
setEffects.description: After the equipping character consumes 1 Nightsoul point while on the field, CRIT Rate increases by 40% for 6s. This effect can trigger once every second.

parts.name: Reckoning of the Xenogenic
parts.description: A flower meticulously carved from black crystal. It emits a mysterious light at night.

parts.name: Crown of the Saints
parts.description: A crown made of obsidian that in ancient times was used in coronation ceremonies by noble tribal kings.

parts.name: Root of the Spirit-Marrow
parts.description: A feathered accessory made in imitation of an ancient dragon's wing. Perhaps it was once a memento of some forgotten history.

parts.name: Pre-Banquet of the Contenders
parts.description: A vessel that seems to have been made by twisting and forming stone in a seemingly whimsical fashion. But it is an open question as to who possesses such strength...

parts.name: Myths of the Night Realm
parts.description: A mysterious ritual element that is neither a timepiece nor a compass. Nowadays, no one has any idea what it is used for.

setEffects.name: Long Night's Oath
setEffects.description: Plunging Attack DMG increased by 25%.

setEffects.name: Long Night's Oath
setEffects.description: After the equipping character's Plunging Attack/Charged Attack/Elemental Skill hits an opponent, they will gain 1/2/2 stack(s) of "Radiance Everlasting." Plunging Attacks, Charged Attacks, or Elemental Skills can each trigger this effect once every 1s. Radiance Everlasting: Plunging Attacks deal 15% increased DMG for 6s. Max 5 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

parts.name: Lightkeeper's Pledge
parts.description: A metal flower that was worn by the Ratniki. It symbolizes the oath of eternal vigilance taken by its original owner.

parts.name: Dyed Tassel
parts.description: An ancient heavy helmet. It is an heirloom that bears the mark of a venerable lineage of northern warriors.

parts.name: Nightingale's Tail Feather
parts.description: A hat ornament intricately crafted from the feathers of a nightingale. They say that its form was first conceived by the original Torchforger.

parts.name: A Horn Unwinded
parts.description: A horn that was once used to summon those who had sworn oaths. It has long since lost its purpose.

parts.name: Undying One's Mourning Bell
parts.description: A bronze bell that was carried by a warrior who walked through the dark abyss. Its peal can be heard on pitch-black nights.

setEffects.name: Finale of the Deep Galleries
setEffects.description: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%

setEffects.name: Finale of the Deep Galleries
setEffects.description: When the equipping character has 0 Elemental Energy, Normal Attack DMG is increased by 60% and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 60%. After the equipping character deals Normal Attack DMG, the aforementioned Elemental Burst effect will stop applying for 6s. After the equipping character deals Elemental Burst DMG, the aforementioned Normal Attack effect will stop applying for 6s. This effect can trigger even if the equipping character is off the field.

parts.name: Deep Gallery's Echoing Song
parts.description: An icy flower fashioned from northland jade. Over the course of its long life, its petals have crumbled to dust.

parts.name: Deep Gallery's Lost Crown
parts.description: A helmet steeped in obsession, just like the mind of its previous owner. Its jade ornamentation seems to come from an age more ancient still.

parts.name: Deep Gallery's Distant Pact
parts.description: A feathered accessory fashioned from northland jade that shimmers with an otherworldly glow.

parts.name: Deep Gallery's Bestowed Banquet
parts.description: A cup fashioned from northland jade. They say that the people of an ancient civilization once used it as a ceremonial vessel to make offerings to the heavens.

parts.name: Deep Gallery's Moment of Oblivion
parts.description: A pocket watch fashioned from northland jade. Its hands are forever frozen in the moment of its destruction.

setEffects.name: Night of the Sky's Unveiling
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Night of the Sky's Unveiling
setEffects.description: When nearby party members trigger Lunar Reactions, if the equipping character is on the field, gain the Gleaming Moon: Intent effect for 4s: Increases CRIT Rate by 15%/30% when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

parts.name: Bloom of the Mind's Desire
parts.description: A sacred relic carved in the shape of a flower. It seems to represent a terrifying presence that unfurls like a bloom.

parts.name: Crown of the Befallen
parts.description: A crown modeled on the circlet worn by a sinner. Perhaps in someone's heart, love and sin flow from the same source.

parts.name: Feather of Indelible Sin
parts.description: A feathered accessory once worn on a felt hat. It feels out of place among the nobles of Snezhnaya and their taste for splendor.

parts.name: Vessel of Plenty
parts.description: A specially crafted goblet used for palace banquets. It was once employed to perform some kind of magic.

parts.name: Revelation's Toll
parts.description: An exquisite chiming clock driven by a mysterious power. It does not seem that timekeeping is its purpose.

setEffects.name: Silken Moon's Serenade
setEffects.description: Energy Recharge +20%.

setEffects.name: Silken Moon's Serenade
setEffects.description: When dealing Elemental DMG, gain the Gleaming Moon: Devotion effect for 8s: Increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 60/120 when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

parts.name: Crystal Tear of the Wanderer
parts.description: An immaculate flower whose beauty is said to have been preserved for eternity by the icy wind.

parts.name: Holy Crown of the Believer
parts.description: An immaculate adornment created in imitation of the envoy of the grove's antlers.

parts.name: Pristine Plume of the Blessed
parts.description: An immaculate feathered accessory said to have been forged by the first Moonchanter herself.

parts.name: Joyous Glory of the Pure
parts.description: An immaculate silver cup said to have been used in the bygone rituals of the Frostmoon Scions. Their modern rites have no need for such a vessel.

parts.name: Frost Devotee's Delirium
parts.description: An immaculate timepiece that long ago ceased turning, along with the delusions of its former owner.

setEffects.name: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon
setEffects.description: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

setEffects.name: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon
setEffects.description: When the equipping character is off-field, Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 20%. When the party's Moonsign Level is at least Ascendant Gleam, Lunar Reaction DMG will be further increased by 40%. This effect will disappear after the equipping character is active for 3s.

parts.name: Moonlit Offering's Opulent Dream
parts.description: A meticulously carved floral ornament meant to highlight the resplendent beauty of the goddesses of the heavenly moons, crafted in ancient times by artisans who sculpted statues of them.

parts.name: Moonlit Offering's Silver Crown
parts.description: A silver circlet set aside at the final syllable of a hymn, worn by poets who, in ancient times, sang in praise of the heavenly moons.

parts.name: Moonlit Offering's Parting Light
parts.description: A quill that, in ancient times, granted boundless inspiration to priests who penned prayers to the heavenly moons.

parts.name: Moonlit Offering's Libation
parts.description: A wine cup lost in the final revelry of an ancient rite, in which believers once offered sacrifices to the heavenly moons.

parts.name: Moonlit Offering's Final Hour
parts.description: An hourglass meant to commemorate the final hour, prepared by sages who, in ancient times, sought truth from the heavenly moons.

name: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

setEffects.name: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
A Day Carved From Rising Winds
setEffects.description: After a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blessing of Pastoral Winds effect for 6s: ATK is increased by 25%. If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, Blessing of Pastoral Winds will be upgraded to Resolve of Pastoral Winds, which additionally increases the CRIT Rate of the equipping character by 20%. This effect can be triggered even when the character is off-field.

parts.name: Windborne Flower's Spruchdichtung
parts.description: An azure crystal bloom that never withers, said to have once belonged, in ages past, to a wandering girl who invoked the thousand winds and countless flowers.

parts.name: Minnesang of Love and Lament
parts.description: A luxurious hair accessory adorned with jade and azure crystals, said to have once been a token bestowed by the Lord of Storm upon a favored recipient in ages past.

parts.name: Dawn's Brilliant Oath
parts.description: A feather accessory of azure, clear as the dawn, said to have once belonged to a guard who cast aside his name in ages past.

parts.name: Heldenepos's Unspoken Tale
parts.description: An ancient goblet, its azure surface weathered by time. It is rumored to have belonged to an unnamed bard in ages past.

parts.name: A Note in Spring's Leich
parts.description: An hourglass filled with azure sand. For reasons unknown, no matter how it is turned, the grains within it refuse to stir.

setEffects.name: Celestial Gift
setEffects.description: Energy Recharge +20%.

setEffects.name: Celestial Gift
setEffects.description: If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, after they use an Elemental Skill, they gain "Light's Guidance" for 20s: All nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to the equipping character's Elemental Type. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. DMG Bonuses provided by Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.\n· When your party has the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, Light's Guidance is upgraded to "Mortal Hymn": All nearby party members gain a 40% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to both the equipping character and the current active party member's Elemental Type instead. If both characters have the same Elemental Type, these bonuses will not stack.

parts.name: Heavensent Fragrance
parts.description: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.

parts.name: Heavensent Crown
parts.description: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.

parts.name: Heavensent Demise
parts.description: The high heavens bestowed a feather of rebirth on their envoy, with all sin to be forgiven where even fate meets its very end.

parts.name: Heavensent Reward
parts.description: The high heavens bestowed sweet nectar on their envoy, and the unending feast opened wide the doors to desire.

parts.name: Heavensent Decree
parts.description: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.

setEffects.name: Disenchantment in Deep Shadow
setEffects.description: Increases Superconduct Reaction DMG by 80%. When the equipping character attacks opponents affected by Superconduct, this attack's CRIT Rate is increased by 16%. An all-new blessing may be obtained as you make your way toward Snezhnaya...

parts.name: Iridescence That Ceased Amidst Glory
parts.description: It was a flower made of silk, gifted to her by a friend whose hands were as cold as ice.

parts.name: Pendulum That Ceased Amidst a Great Fall
parts.description: It was a delicate trinket awarded to her in praise by the hand of her only master.

parts.name: Sharpness That Ceased Upon Wondrous Creation
parts.description: It was a feathered quill given to her followers, once used to pen the most absurd of dreams.

parts.name: Ovations That Ceased Upon Festivity
parts.description: It was a goblet of wine she had accepted in celebration from the hands of a colleague.

parts.name: Moment That Ceased Upon Waking From Grand Dreams
parts.description: It was a fleeting moment she gave a certain silent alchemist to remind him of every item on his schedule.
